concept.hr: Klijent sam upisuje svoj zapis; vlasnik zapisa je SID, pa novi račun ne smije
concept.en: Clients register their own records; the owner is a SID, so a new account can't

summary.hr: PC1 sam upisuje zapis u zonu: nepotpisano odbijeno, potpisano prihvaćeno. Reinstaliran s novim SID-om ne smije mijenjati svoj stari zapis.
summary.en: PC1 writes its own record: unsigned refused, signed accepted. Rebuilt with a new SID, it may not change its old record.
